commit.message:
Lint/pyflakes unused code (#1860)

* Remove unused imports, variables and f-string prefixes

Dead code found by ruff's pyflakes rules: 64 unused imports (F401),
27 unused locals (F841) and 9 f-strings without placeholders (F541).

Calls with side effects are preserved: the tqdm progress bar in dwq.py
and mx.distributed.init() in dynamic_quant.py keep their calls and lose
only the unused binding.

* Fix stale tokenizer references and a duplicate dict key

server.py: the batching path read `tokenizer`, which is only bound in
the other branch that loads a model. It works today because the local
survives across iterations of the generation loop, but it should be
`current_tokenizer`, as the adjacent _tokenize call already uses.

test_models.py: the llama4_text config set head_dim twice (32 then 8).
Python keeps the last, so 8 is what the test has always used; the
shadowed 32 is removed to keep behaviour identical.

* Enforce pyflakes with ruff in pre-commit

Adds ruff restricted to the pyflakes (F) rules, so black and isort keep
sole responsibility for formatting and import order. Package
initialisers are exempt from F401 because they re-export public names.

* Update comments

* Remove self-assignment

* Remove unused loop variables

* Propagate exceptions

* Fix mutable defaults

* Fix missing Optional

* Mark some variables as unused

* Set target version in ruff.toml

* Add missing copyright in files

* Fix style

* Modify style
